criteria.text:
On the stand with the real model (root): the WB/Ozon post with the checkbox asks for the position and without it
is never downgraded; Iceland with research leaves no «25 тысяч» as confirmed and `ungrounded` is not empty;
enrichment + adaptation puts researched numbers into the post and invents no advice; `**` is bold on screen and
`<b>` in the post body; fact check of a long text searches by claims; «Убрать следы ИИ» keeps the before/after
count after F5; with «Ключи системы» the key block is hidden and search spends included quota.
Locally: `tsc --noEmit` × 3 apps, three halves of `pnpm test` under Node 22, design guards,
`scripts/orchestration/run_process_verification.sh`, empty `prisma migrate diff`, `mastra_*` 29→29 at release.

Execute 97dq.1 through 97dq.8; 97dq.9 (acceptance, live-model stand proof, release, ninth walk page) belongs to the Claude root. Streams S1 S2 S5 first, then S3 S4 S6, then S7; S8 only after the owner approves the design canvas. At most three parallel write streams, each in its own worktree branch agent/97dq-sN from wave/walk-2026-09-18; integrate one at a time, S2 before S3. No schema changes. Guarded AI prompts and contracts are versioned by successor modules. Streams never push, deploy or make paid calls. Owner authorized on 18.09.2026: paid model and search calls on the local stand, push to the private origin, production release after green acceptance; rollback 3504f07a8f25; stop and ask if host free disk is below 6 GB before pull. Batch-close and read back Beads only after all workers stopped. No unrelated cleanup.
